results.title: Sleeping Alone
results.overview: A young woman attempts to enjoy a night of house-sitting in a couple's countryside home.

results.title: Silencio
results.overview: A medieval peasant suffering from the plague encounters the spirit of his dead wife as he wanders into the forest.

results.title: Nice Girls
results.overview: A maverick cop and a meticulous detective join forces with a charming ex-hacker to solve an officer's disappearance and save Nice from disaster.

results.title: Big Cats
results.overview: When Ichabod Price, a respected cryptozoologist, decides to shoot a documentary about alleged panther sightings in the English countryside, he soon discovers more than just big cats lurking in the woods.

results.title: The Beast Within
results.overview: Ten-year-old Willow follows her parents on one of their secret late-night treks to the heart of an ancient forest. After witnessing her father undergo a terrible transformation, she too becomes ensnared by the dark ancestral secret that they've so desperately tried to conceal.

results.title: The Baptism
results.overview: Hatred, intolerance, polarization. In the past few years, Brazil transformed into a battlefield, where dialogue became impossible. The Baptism depicts this phenomenon and its consequences through the relationship between two brothers which lives are completely different from each other.

results.title: The Critic
results.overview: Jimmy Erskine is the most feared theatre critic of the age. He lives as flamboyantly as he writes and takes pleasure in savagely taking down any actor who fails to meet his standards. When the owner of the Daily Chronicle dies, and his son takes over, Jimmy quickly finds himself at odds with his new boss and his position under threat. In an attempt to preserve the power and influence he holds so sacred, Jimmy strikes a Faustian pact with a struggling actress, entangling them and the boss in a thrilling but deadly web of desire, blackmail, and betrayal.

results.title: At Capacity
results.overview: Mia has one task for the evening: break up with the smooth-talking charlatan, Andrew. When things don’t go according to plan, she’s pulled into an unexpected evening with Andrew’s cousin, Ari. As a seasoned political operative, Mia has strong opinions on the way the world works. However, with the earnest and endearing Ari, she’s met her match. A film about connection, the ways we protect one another, and the potential for serendipity when we live moment to moment.

results.title: Dreamscape
results.overview: A tired writer lacks the energy or ambition to keep writing. The writer then gets transported into a DREAMSCAPE where he travels to his dreams and has an adventure of a lifetime...

results.title: In Her Place
results.overview: After Chilean writer María Carolina Geel murders her lover, the case captivates shy legal secretary Mercedes, sparking a connection between the two women.

results.title: Souleymane's Story
results.overview: As he pedals through the streets of Paris to deliver meals, Souleymane recounts his story. In two days, he has to go through his asylum application interview, the key to obtaining papers, but Souleymane is not ready.

results.title: Nightfaces
results.overview: A taxi driver kicks a homeless woman out of his car. It'll be a long night until he can make amends.

results.title: Krista
results.overview: Krista is happy with the simple life she’s living with the husband she loves very much. But her ambitious husband ends up losing big at cockfighting, forcing him to commit a crime, and leading Krista to use her body to save him.

results.title: Intentional
results.overview: A team of discordant film students struggles to finish their film while an unknown entity attempts to sabotage their efforts, forcing them to unify to understand what is threatening them.

results.title: In Bloom
results.overview: Explores characters at life-defining moments regarding gender issues like period poverty, child marriage, HIV stigma, family planning, and women's empowerment.

results.title: Substitute Happiness
results.overview: Ezequiel, a 40-year-old film director, has had a career marked by successes and failures.

results.title: Северный Свет
results.overview: A story about abandoned churches in northwest Russia.

results.title: Greener Pastures
results.overview: Contemplating the future of farming in America through the day-to-day lives of four small, Midwestern, multigenerational family farms over the course of three years.

results.title: Hear Me: Our Summer
results.overview: A job seeking dreamer Yong-jun works part-time at his parents' lunch box house. Yeo-reum lives only to support for hearing-impaired swimmer sister. One day, Yong-jun meets Yeo-reum while delivering lunch boxes and falls in love at the first sight. Yeo-reum slowly opens her heart to warm-hearted Yong-jun.
